name: green-view-backend
description: Standalone backend for the Green View (cesium-demo) app: automated balcony viewpoint generation (Puppeteer-driven capture + GVI analysis), backed by Postgres. Independent from the digital-twin admin backend in /backend — shares only the same Postgres database via its own gv_-prefixed tables.

scripts.migrate:up: node -r dotenv/config ./node_modules/node-pg-migrate/bin/node-pg-migrate up -m src/db/migrations --migration-file-language js --migrations-table gv_pgmigrations
scripts.migrate:down: node -r dotenv/config ./node_modules/node-pg-migrate/bin/node-pg-migrate down -m src/db/migrations --migration-file-language js --migrations-table gv_pgmigrations
